subject: Renewal & capacity upsell — change in billing owner + PO routing
messages:
From: Jordan Klein <jordan.k@stellarnet.com>
To: maya.srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarnet.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Billing owner switch for renewal + PO for additional capacity

Maya —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with the capacity add-on and roll the renewal into the expanded commitment. Finance asked that the invoice be issued to our parent entity (Stellarnet Holdings, EIN 12-3456789) instead of the business unit that signed originally.

Attached is our formal PO (PO_Stellarnet_4567.pdf) that references the capacity increase and updated spend. Can you confirm the next steps so our AP can route the PO correctly and we can get the PO applied to the renewal?

One more ask: Stellarnet accounting prefers Net45 on renewals for enterprise deals. Is that something Redwood can accommodate for this renewal term? If needed, we can get a signature on an amendment.

Files: PO_Stellarnet_4567.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan Klein
Finance Manager — Stellarnet
Jordan.K@stellarnet.com

From: maya.srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Klein <jordan.k@stellarnet.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing owner switch for renewal + PO for additional capacity

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the PO and clarity on payor. Quick answers and next steps from our side:

- We can route invoices to Stellarnet Holdings; billing will need a completed W-9/EIN confirmation for the new payor before we change the invoice entity. Could you send a scanned W-9 or the official EIN letter?
- Net45 is not our standard for self-serve credits but is commonly approved for enterprise renewals with a short credit check and an amendment sign-off. I'll loop in Billing Ops (Vivek) and Renewals (Marissa) to get their read.
- I'll create a mutual action plan and add milestones: receipt of W-9/EIN, PO application, amendment (if Net45), and effective invoice entity change date.

For now please send: payor legal name, billing address, AP contact (name + email), and the EIN document. That will let billing produce a quote-invoice and map the PO.

Attaching a short W-9 intake form to make the steps easier.
Attachment: Redwood_W9_Form.pdf

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0184

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarnet.com>
To: maya.srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Klein <jordan.k@stellarnet.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing owner switch for renewal + PO for additional capacity

Maya / Marissa —

Thanks — attaching the EIN proof and the signed PO. Our AP will only pay once the invoice is addressed to Stellarnet Holdings, so the change needs to be reflected on the invoice PDF.

Requested details below:
- Payor: Stellarnet Holdings, Inc.
- Billing address: 1200 Harbor Way, Suite 240, San Mateo, CA 94404
- AP contact: Celia Ramirez <celia.ramirez@stellarnet.com>, +1 (650) 555-0123
- EIN doc: EIN_Stellarnet_letter.pdf (attached)
- PO: PO_Stellarnet_4567.pdf (attached)

On net terms: our procurement prefers Net45 for annual renewals across the group. If Redwood requires a brief credit review and an amendment, we can route the amendment to our Legal. Please confirm the expected timeline to reflect Net45 on the renewed/expanded invoice.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Sr. Procurement Ops — Stellarnet
priya.shah@stellarnet.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarnet.com>, Jordan Klein <jordan.k@stellarnet.com>
Cc: maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing owner switch for renewal + PO for additional capacity

Hi Priya / Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for sending the PO + EIN. Vivek and I reviewed with Billing Ops — we can approve Net45 for this renewal and the capacity top-up, subject to the following checklist (should be quick):

1) Billing has a signed amendment that references Net45 and the expanded commitment (I attached a short draft for Stellarnet to review).
2) Completed W-9 / EIN on file (received).
3) PO applied to the renewal in our billing system (we will ingest PO_Stellarnet_4567.pdf this morning).
4) Finance sign-off: final invoice will be issued to Stellarnet Holdings, Inc. and routed to Celia Ramirez at the AP contact info you provided.

Action items:
- Priya: please run the attached amendment by your Legal and confirm signature by end of week if possible. Link to draft: https://app.redwood.com/drafts/renewal-0789
- Maya & Marissa: we'll ingest the PO and flag the account for Net45. Vivek will follow up if we need additional credit references.
- Jordan / Celia: once amendment is signed, expect invoice to be generated the same business day and routed to Celia for payment.

Attachment: renewal_amendment_draft.pdf

If any of the dates are tight, we can set an interim invoice that applies credits once the entity change clears, but I think we can do a clean swap at renewal with the signed amendment.

Marissa Cole
Renewals Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142
